  • Privacy, surveillance, digital identity, biometrics, Greece's Personal Number, eID wallets, cashless systems, CBDCs, and programmable money.

  • Cybersecurity, hacking ethics, autonomous weapons, algorithmic government, social scoring, censorship, elections, and political persuasion.
  • Evidence atlas, claim-confidence markings, historical false alarms, source-authority ladder, research trail, glossary, Scripture map, and a practical Christian decision framework.

Who It Is For

  • Christians who want a serious, source-aware framework for technology and prophecy questions.

DISCERNMENT FIRST

A Reference For Discernment, Not A Prediction Manual

The book is an educational study, not an official ecclesiastical document and not a substitute for a priest or spiritual father. It deliberately refuses to label a current technology as the final fulfillment of prophecy merely because it resembles one feature of a biblical passage.

Product FAQ

Which languages are included?

Separate English and Greek PDF editions are included with the purchase.

How are doctrine, interpretation, and technical claims separated?

The theological center is Eastern Orthodox Christianity. Scripture, patristic testimony, Orthodox conciliar and social teaching, and clearly identified historical or technical sources are used with different confidence labels.
